paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : WMT15 De

annotations.annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU score across different conditions. The x-axis represents "Average Lagging (AL)" with a linear scale ranging from -1 to 10.0, marked in unspecified units, and tick labels at intervals of 2.5. The y-axis represents "BLEU" with a linear scale ranging from 18 to 28, with tick labels at intervals of 2. The plot features four lines: a lavender line with circle markers and a dashed style, representing "Consistency-CE," starts at approximately (0.0, 19) and ends around (10, 26), showing a gradual increase; a darker purple line with square markers and a dashed style, representing "Inconsistency-CE," starts around (0.0, 20) and finishes near (10, 26), also displaying an upward trend; a blue line with square markers and dashed style, "Inconsistency-CE-MP," begins at (0.0, 18) and ends at (10, 26.5), reflecting an increase across the axis; and a red line with star markers and solid style, "Consistency-Bi," starts at around (0.0, 20) and ends at (10, 28), showing a steady rise except (8.0, 29). The dark purple line intersects the dark blue line at an x-value of approximately 1 and the purple line at approximately 2. A legend is available on the bottom right of the plot to infer different lines by their styles.
